step_a: Transpose each source component locally about its bounding-box origin into a fresh grid.
intermediate: The transformed grid and its recomputed same-color four-connected components and occupied-cell areas.
step_b: Keep every transformed component tied for the selected largest or smallest occupied-cell area.
why_b_depends_on_a: Separate same-color source components can become adjacent and merge after transposition, changing both component membership and the area ranking used by selection.

(rule! (lambda (g) (let ((g (let* ((stage g) (groups (objects stage 0)))
      (if (empty? groups) stage
        (let* ((score (lambda (obj) (obj-size obj)))
               (best (apply max (map score groups)))
               (eligible (filter (lambda (obj) (= (score obj) best)) groups)))
          (for*/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows stage) (cols stage) 0)))
                     ((obj (in-list eligible)) (p (in-list (obj-cells obj))))
            (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (at stage (first p) (second p))))))))) (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list (objects g 0))])
    (let ((cells (map (lambda (p)
                        (list (+ (obj-r1 obj) (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj)))
                              (+ (obj-c1 obj) (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)))))
                      (obj-cells obj))))
      (paint-cells out cells (obj-color obj)))))))
